headline: UBS has 608 live AI use cases in production, up 81% YoY
body: UBS said in its third-quarter 2026 results that it has 608 live AI use cases in production, up 81% YoY, with more than 1,090 applications in development. The bank also said its employees are running over 12,700 AI personal agents in their daily activities.
note: The split between live cases and the 1,090-plus applications in development is a useful read on what is actually in production.

figure.label: live AI use cases in production, UBS third quarter 2026

evidence.text: We continue to progress our 9 large-scale, end-to-end transformational AI initiatives and build on our 608 live AI use cases in production (81% YoY increase, with another 1,090+ applications in development).
Our employees are running over 12,700 AI personal agents to support them in their daily activities.
